question: What is the name of the evacuation operation conducted by the Government of India to evacuate the Indian citizens amidst the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Operation Ganga**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Operation Ganga** was a significant evacuation mission led by the Indian government to rescue its citizens stranded in neighbouring countries of **Ukraine during the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.**
 
• The operation involved the transportation of Indian nationals from** Romania, Hungary, Poland, Moldova, and Slovakia back** to India, with assistance from these countries.
 
• **Prime Minister Narendra Modi **held a crucial phone call with** Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy **on 26 February 2022, during which they discussed various issues, including the safety of Indian students in Ukraine.
 
• The first evacuation flight departed from Bucharest and arrived in New Delhi with 249 nationals at approximately 2:55 am Indian Standard Time (IST) on 27 February.
 
• Following this, four union ministers—Hardeep Singh Puri, Jyotiraditya Scindia, Kiren Rijiju, and V.K. Singh—were dispatched to neighbouring countries of Ukraine the next day to aid in coordinating efforts with local authorities and prioritize the evacuation process.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Operation Eagle Claw **was an ill-fated rescue attempt by the US military in 1980 aimed at freeing 52 embassy personnel held hostage in Tehran during the Iran hostage crisis.
 
• Executed on April 24–25, 1980, the operation was the culmination of five months of meticulous planning involving the Central Intelligence Agency and personnel from various branches of the armed forces.
 
• The mission underscored shortcomings in the US military's operational coordination and ultimately spurred the establishment of the United States Special Operations Command (SOCOM) in 1987.
